blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Rep. Gerville Luistro praised former law dean Ralph Sarmiento on Thursday for his reason for declining to be a defense witness in Vice President Sara Z. Duterte’s impeachment trial. In an interview on ANC’s “Headstart” with Karen Davila, Luistro, the lead House prosecutor, said she appreciated Sarmiento’s explanation that he would like to keep his constitutional law views independent. Sarmiento, a former University of St. La Salle College of Law dean, had been expected to open the defense presentation when the trial resumes Nov. 9.
